_disclaimer: Module C, Milestone 2 UPDATE: this table is now VERIFIED against the real raw file (all 151 real columns covered, confirmed by exact-match diff against the live file header -- see docs/moduleC_milestone2_real_data_validation.md Section B/F). Supersedes the ~29-entry Milestone 1 provisional table, which was based on secondary-source documentation only. grade/sub_grade/int_rate remain an explicitly UNRESOLVED circularity group per Milestone 1 Section 4 -- this milestone does not resolve that question, only re-confirms it against real data. leakage_concern is populated only when available_at_application is 'no' or 'unknown' (an actual timing/circularity risk); for 'yes' entries, any clarifying note (e.g. distinguishing a bureau-pull field from this loan's own outcome) is folded into proposed_use instead, so leakage_concern consistently means 'this field carries a real exclusion risk’, never ‘here is unrelated context’.
